Wait for the given number of milliseconds (1000 ms = 1 second). This pauses the main program; avoid long waits when loop must service motors, music files or serial input.

Purpose: Read a button and change an LED. The input needs the pull-up or wiring described in the blocks. Wiring: Button between D2 and GND; internal pull-up is enabled. The output is the built-in D13 LED. Try: Swap the HIGH/LOW actions to make the LED light when the button is released.
